Typhoon Dolphin Impacts Japan and China, Disrupts Flights

Typhoon Dolphin made landfall in Japan's Okinawa prefecture, causing power outages and injuring at least six people. In Kagoshima, nearly 39,000 buildings lost power, while Okinawa saw over 12,000 affected. China closed ports and shut down schools and tourist activities in eastern regions as the storm approached. The typhoon also led to the cancellation of approximately 500 flights in Japan and disrupted travel for Hong Kong residents, grounding flights connecting the city with mainland China, Taiwan, and Japan. Taipei criticized China's traffic controls in the Taiwan Strait amid the typhoon.
